title: Scenes containing references to TSCN files break when project is closed and reopened (Export References, ResourcePreloader Nodes)
body:
### Tested versions

Occurs in 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400 CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

While creating a scene management system, I used script references to TSCN files to reference their entries in ResourcePreloader nodes.

When closing and restarting the project, any scenes containing scripts with such references or ResourcePreloader nodes containing scene references experience a Dependency Error.

This occurs when using script variables and ResourcePreloader nodes by themselves

If this is expected behavior, there must at least be a warning given by the engine that this will break the scenes.

### Steps to reproduce

Have any number of scenes.

Create a script with a Resource-type variable, then drag the other scene into that reference.

Alternatively, create a ResourcePreloader node, then add the other scene to its list.

Save the scene, then reopen it- note that this works.

Close the project, then reopen it- note that this is what breaks both scenes.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[DependencyBreak.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21946106/DependencyBreak.zip)
